text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
Gooooooo for it!
Craaaaaaft!!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
—Kh!
Yaaaaaaaagh!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... ha—!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ...You've gotten faster again.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, look at Heart-san and the others too!
They've leveled up so much
since the Shuka Sho...!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: I'm sure that's why... look, check it out!

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
WAAAAAHHHH!!
CRAFT! HEART!!
MESSIAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Wow! Ahaha, my ears are practically ringing!
What incredible cheering...!"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Right! —Together, we made
everyone who came here feel that excitement.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...Everyone, you can feel the quickening of a new era woven by the Tiara Umamusume, can you not?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"I can feel the immense amount of attention and expectations...
being directed at us."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
“—All the more reason why.
Next, I wish to challenge the senior racers in a race...
and prove that I have the strength worthy of carrying the new era.”

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
...! Messiah-san, which Tiara
senior Umamusume do you want to challenge!?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Naturally. ...It's Air Groove-senpai.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Because you have supported and guided me time and again,
I believe the greatest way to repay you is to show my strength.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
The feelings and the strength passed down to me...
Now is the time to show them before my senior.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Whoa...!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: That's gonna make for an incredible race, isn't it!?

The moment she returned to the waiting room, Rhein Kraft
told me that in sheer excitement.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
It's gonna get super, super, super, super high attention!
Today's race will surely surpass even that last graded stakes—!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
If I can win there... truly.
I'll be able to show you a back that shines so brightly, won't I?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Dazzling. Strong. Irresistibly inspiring.
A back that makes you want to chase after it...!
choice_data_list: Yeah, that's got to be it.
Yeah, there's no doubt about it.

text_block_list.text:
Thinking it was a good opportunity, I pulled out documents
regarding the race I was thinking of targeting next
while giving my answer.

Triumph over fierce battles with the senior Tiara Umamusume, show them the back of the runner they admire.
Leave behind a run of her own.

Thinking it would be the perfect fit for her wish,
the race I suggested was—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: This year's Sprinters Stakes... you say?!
choice_data_list: Right, it's the race to decide the fastest Umamusume of the autumn.
Right, it's the race to decide the fastest Umamusume of the autumn!

text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl, who had always specialized
in sprint and mile courses—

And Nishino Flower and Daiichi Ruby,
former champions of this race,
will surely have their sights set on it as well.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ...The Umamusume who conquered the world. The genius girl crowned Sprint Queen. The leader of the 'Illustrious Lineage.'

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"If it's me," huh...
...You really believe in me that much, don't you!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Understood. Let's go.
...No, please let me go!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: "At the Sprinters Stakes, I will prove it without fail!"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: That back I look up to, without fail—!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
That's right. I'm going to do it at the Sprinters Stakes!
I'll train a whole bunch with Trainer all summer long, and then...!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: And so, ...that's, why—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: —I knew it!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
That's Cesario over there!
And—!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...I see. A horse girl who competes on the Triple Crown path,
and someday takes on the world, huh...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Green Scrunchie
text_block_list.text:
Yes! So please teach me
a whole bunch of things!!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, leave it to me.
Alright, first off—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(A little Umamusume! So cute~!
Is Cesario helping her with her running...?)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, how wonderful!
Cesario's dream is coming true...!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(Could this be something that happens in the future?
Even though Cesario looks the same as she does now.
No, but——!)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure that's it! Because it's so lovely.
It's definitely much better if it is!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, sounds great~!
Ahahahahaha—

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Lady
text_block_list.text:
Hey! Wake up!
Little missy!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Mnyaa!?

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Lady
text_block_list.text: You're a Tracen Academy student, right!? Going straight to sleep after eating is bad for your digestion!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"W-Wah, huh...!? Huh, what!?
I-I'm so sorry...!"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(H-Huh~...!?
When did I fall asleep!?)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: (...Lately, there's been a lot of this sort of thing—)

text_block_list.name: Short-Haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Well then, Mother-in-law.
We'll be heading out for our walk now.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: (—Huh? This voice...)

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Lady
text_block_list.text:
Here you go!
Watch out for cars on your way back~!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, excuse me!
Thank you for the meal!
I'll leave the money here!

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Lady
text_block_list.text:
Ah!? Hey, you!?
Running right after eating is bad for you, too!!
...Aaand she's not listening.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa, haa...!
No way... No, but without a doubt...!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(That voice I heard back at the ramen shop.
And that figure I'm chasing after right now.)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(I know it. Absolutely, without a doubt.
There's no way I'm wrong! Because—!)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me! Sorry to bother you so suddenly!
Are you—an Oaks-winning Umamusume!?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: (She slowly turns around. That expression of hers—is just like it was back then.)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I-I watched your race
and fell in love with the Tiara route!
I watched it with my mom when I was little—...!

text_block_list.name: Baby
text_block_list.text:
Heh... sniffle...
Waaaaaaaahhhhh—...!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Huh!? A-A baby...!?

text_block_list.name: Short-Haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
There, there, you're okay~.
Good girl, goood girl~, nothing to be scared of~.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Wah!? Whoa-whoa!?
I'm so sorry! It's all my fault...!"

text_block_list.name: Short-Haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha. You did nothing wrong.
Calm down, calm down~.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry.
For speaking to you out of the blue like this...

text_block_list.name: Short-Haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Not at all!
If anything, it's an honor to be called out to by the one and only Rhein Kraft~.

text_block_list.name: Short-Haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text: And to think you were actually a fan of mine back in my active racing days... Wow, you really never know what life has in store, huh~

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Likewise!
I never thought I'd bump into you here of all places...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Besides... to think I'd get to see
your child—!

text_block_list.name: Short-Haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Fufu. It was just born recently. Isn't it adorable~?

text_block_list.name: Baby
text_block_list.text: *giggle* *giggle*...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
~~gh, it's so cute!
Wah, waaah. Waaaaah~~...!

text_block_list.name: Short-Haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Want to try holding it?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Eeeeh!? N-Not that far!
I can't impose on you like that!

text_block_list.name: Short-Haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, I'm totally fine, really.
Hmm~ well then... try putting your fingers like this.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Um... like this?

text_block_list.name: Short-Haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Right. Just like that.
Keep getting closer, bit by bit—
(Squeeze...)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Wah, waaahhh...
T-Their little hand, their tiny little hand is...!
Squeezing my finger so tight...!!

text_block_list.name: Short-Haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. How did the baby feel?
Super soft and fluffy, right~?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes!
It's so fluffy and soft...!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ...It's so warm.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: "...I wonder if this little one will run in races someday too, just like you."

text_block_list.name: Short-Haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. I don't really know~.
What they end up liking comes after they get a little bigger, after all.

text_block_list.name: Short-Haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
“Still. I might bring them along to the racetrack.
After all, I want to show them your running.”

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Huh.

text_block_list.name: Short-Haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I'm a big fan of your running.
It's just so... straight and pure, like a ray of sunshine.

text_block_list.name: Short-Haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text: "So when this kid grows up and gets interested in racing, I want your races to be the very first ones I show them."

text_block_list.name: Short-Haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"...Anyway, sorry for suddenly making such unreasonable demands.
Like, how many years away is that even, right?"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I can show you, I'm sure of it.
...I'll do my best so that I can!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
So that when this child grows up and goes to watch a race,
—my running will still leave its mark there.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
So that someone might look up to me
and start running too...!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: I'll do my absolute best in the next Sprinters Stakes too!

text_block_list.name: Short-Haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text: ! ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Short-Haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text: —I'm really looking forward to that.
